statement: The CONTAMINATION row of bench/gate.mjs, applied by its own functions, counted 55 bar files at HEAD with 29 carrying no split object (25 with no split, 4 whose split is not an object), and 56 bar files in the working tree with 19 carrying no split object (18 with no split, 1 whose split is not an object): autopilot-board10.json, boundary.json, census-prune.json, census-scale-pruned.json, census-scale-static.json, census.json, code.json, compress-board10.json, compress.json, daemon.json, knowledge.json, math.json, native.json, public-launch.json, recall.json, senses.json, synth.json, web-ladder.json, grid.json. The row still has 2 cause(s), so the bar is not met.

development.what: the gate row (bench/gate.mjs contaminationRow) and the verdict writers were changed against the bar verdicts the row named at HEAD

heldOut.what: none: the row reads every verdict file under bench/verdicts, the same files the writers were changed for

split.contaminated: no held-out set: a census of every verdict file grades the files it was written to fix

bar.rule: node bench/gate.mjs --contamination has no cause: every bar verdict carries a split object and a contaminated one says so
